seo.ogTitle: Production Company Website Case Study: Siddhant Cinevision
seo.ogDescription: A cinematic website for a Mumbai television and film production company with a projects showcase and talent submissions.

h1: Siddhant Cinevision: A Website for a Television and Film Production Company

sections.intro: Siddhant Cinevision Pvt. Ltd. is a Mumbai-based television and film production company. We designed and developed its website to present the company, its founder and its productions in a dark, cinematic style.
overview: A production company's website works as a calling card for broadcasters, collaborators and talent. This one opens with its founder, Manish Goswami, and his role as Founder and Managing Director, so visitors know who is behind the company straight away.
The Projects area highlights featured productions, and a submission form lets aspiring actors send their details, show-reel links and photos.
sections.goalsHeading: What the production company website needed to do
goals: Introduce the company and its founder with credibility.
Give aspiring actors an organised way to submit their portfolio.
Connect visitors to the founder's social and industry profiles.
sections.featuresHeading: What the production company website includes

features.title: A founder-led home page
features.body: A full-screen introduction of the founder sets the tone and builds recognition.

features.title: A projects showcase
features.body: Featured productions are presented together so visitors can see the company's range.

features.title: Talent portfolio submission
features.body: Aspiring actors can submit their name, contact details, show-reel links and photos through a form.

features.title: Social and industry links
features.body: Links to social and industry profiles such as Facebook, Instagram and IMDb sit in the header.

features.title: About Us and contact
features.body: A company story, founder profile and contact form make it easy for industry contacts to reach the team.

features.title: A dark, cinematic design
features.body: A black background with bold yellow accents gives the site a screen-industry look that fits the brand.

sections.audience: Broadcasters, co-producers, actors and other industry professionals, and viewers who follow the company's shows.
